_doc: Candidates KEPT on an edit that provably could not change behaviour. Not a mistake to hide — each is a null control, and the largest gain any of them showed over its parent is a MEASURED noise floor for the benchmark. config_evidence.py labels these rows for the mutator and reports the floor, so the generator stops reading sub-noise deltas as real effects. Identified by hackathon-rnd 2026-08-16 while converting bundles to the config-directory layout.
